description.value: Spice Cart Indian Cuisine is an authentic Indian restaurant in Port Coquitlam specializing in fresh curries, tandoori dishes, and biryani made with traditional spices and high-quality ingredients. The menu features both meat and vegetarian options prepared with time-tested cooking methods. Cyclists can dine in or order for pickup, with delivery also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website successfully loaded and confirms this is a real, operating Indian restaurant at 1475 Prairie Avenue in Port Coquitlam, offering pickup and delivery (confirming takeout). The menu lists Paneer Butter Masala ('Homemade cheese cooked with ginger, garlic in a tomato based butter sauce'), which is a vegetarian dish, confirming vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website address includes unit 'b 104' (1475 Prairie Avenue b 104) not reflected in the OSM address field.
Website branding uses 'SpiceCart' (one word) while OSM name is 'Spice Cart Indian Cuisine' — minor name discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Indian restaurant with confirmed pickup and delivery service; a useful food stop for touring cyclists in Port Coquitlam.
